1. First, calculate \(36 \times 35\):
   \[
   36 \times 35 = 36 \times (30 + 5) = 36 \times 30 + 36 \times 5 = 1080 + 180 = 1260
   \]

2. Next, calculate \(13 \times 29\):
   \[
   13 \times 29 = 13 \times (30 - 1) = 13 \times 30 - 13 \times 1 = 390 - 13 = 377
   \]

3. Now, subtract the second product from the first:
   \[
   1260 - 377 = 883
   \]

Thus, the answer to the main question is 883.
